 Heidi Klum and Jessica Alba Both Wore the Black Jeans Style That’s Super Flattering for Women 45+
 Us Weekly Follow Jessica Booth Tue, November 10, 2026 at 4:30 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Tue, November 10, 2026 at 4:30 PM UTC Getty Images Blue jeans might be a classic wardrobe staple, but Heidi Klum and Jessica Alba have left Us inspired to switch up our denim a little this fall and winter. Both stars recently rocked an effortlessly chic, cool mom look in wide-leg black jeans , and we immediately found a lookalike pair to add to our cart.
 The stars each styled the jeans their own way, and it's hard to say which look we liked the most. Klum, spotted strolling the streets of New York City, kept her black jeans cool-weather-ready with a long black leather trench coat, soft gray sweater and chunky black combat boots. Alba was less covered up, seen in Beverly Hills in a similar pair of baggy black jeans, with an ab-baring crop top, black bomber jacket and gold jewelry. Our search for the same style led us to $45 wide-leg black jeans that look almost exactly the same as theirs.

 Get the Trendy Queen Wide Leg Jeans for $45 at Amazon! Please note, prices are accurate as of the publishing date but are subject to change. 
 The Trendy Queen Wide Leg Jeans on Amazon have all of the same features as both Klum and Alba's jeans, including the wide leg, relaxed fit and long silhouette that nearly brushes the floor. The slightly flared-out wide-leg style makes them extra flattering, especially for older women. The stretchy mid-rise waist is forgiving, and that, combined with the wide leg, helps to elongate your frame.
 Advertisement Advertisement Jessica Alba Wears This Sleek Denim Style With Boots — Copy the Look With This $37 Pair 
 Like Klum's, these black Amazon jeans have a slight white wash that gives them a slightly distressed, lived-in look that feels effortless. And they're designed to be comfortable: the soft denim has just enough stretch to make them flexible and wearable for hours. Plus, we love the raw hem, which makes them come off as a bit edgier and more casual.
 We're not the only ones who have been eyeing these wide-leg jeans for the fall and winter – Amazon shoppers have been buying and giving them rave reviews. "Get these while you can!" one shopper titled their review and added, "My favorite clothing purchase on Amazon. Super comfy and just the right length – I am 5'4. True to size. Stretchy and everyone gives compliments."
 Another shopper wrote, "I have had these for a while now, and I have to say they are some of my favorite jeans. I find myself reaching for them over and over again. The fit is fabulous, and the comfort is top-notch. Would recommend these to anyone."
